newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures steady to higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures steady to higher at close.

text.p: Rubber futures closed steady to slightly higher in moderate trade on some late local buying interest, brokers said on Tuesday.
Traders said there was active interest in nearby supplies of RSS3 rubber, but most players were still to recover from the long Chinese Lunar New Year and Hari Raya Puasa holiday.
"Some speculative buying interest was noted for the RSS3 and TSR20 contracts but the RSS1 contract was untraded. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
"Sentiment was dampened by the closure of the Japanese markets today but we might see some trade tomorrow," he said.
At around 0945 GMT, May RSS3 rose four cents to 128.00 U.S. cents a kg.
March RSS1 was indicated at 173.50 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg compared with last Thursday's settlement of 171.75 cents.
May TSR20 was unchanged from last Thursday's settlement of 170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg.
